description: This is a test class for the UpdateFilter class, containing unit tests to verify authentication and superuser role checks within the OpenMRS web application.

classes.name: UpdateFilterTest
classes.description: Test suite for the UpdateFilter class, verifying superuser authentication and role validation.

methods.name: authenticateAsSuperUser_shouldReturnFalseIfGivenInvalidCredentials
methods.description: Tests that authenticateAsSuperUser returns false for invalid username and password.

methods.name: authenticateAsSuperUser_shouldReturnFalseIfGivenUserIsNotSuperuser
methods.description: Tests that authenticateAsSuperUser returns false when the user exists but is not a superuser.

methods.name: authenticateAsSuperUser_shouldReturnTrueIfGivenUserIsSuperuser
methods.description: Tests that authenticateAsSuperUser returns true for an admin user.

methods.name: isSuperUser_shouldReturnTrueIfGivenUserHasSuperuserRole
methods.description: Checks that isSuperUser correctly identifies a user with a superuser role.

methods.name: isSuperUser_shouldReturnFalseIfGivenUserDoesNotHaveTheSuperUserRole
methods.description: Checks that isSuperUser returns false when the user does not have a superuser role.
